detail.title: CP-UNP-E3221L18-DAQ
detail.overview: 2MP WDR 32x IR Network PTZ Camera- 180 Mtr.
features: WDR(120dB), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Day/Night(ICR), ROI, Defog, AWB, BLC, HLC
Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro

General.Minimum IR: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.6, B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.6, 0 lux (IR light on)
General.White Balance: Auto, Indoor, Outdoor, ATW, Manual, Sodium lamp, Natural light, Street lamp
General.Bit Rate: H265: 188 kbps–6400 kbps, H264: 216 kbps–8192 kbps
General.Pan/ Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360°, Endless, Tilt: –15° to +90°, Auto flip 180°
General.OSD: Channel Title, Time Title, OSD Info (PTZ Coordinate Zoom North, Pattern Temperature,  Preset, Location, Input Text, Text Alignment), Font Properties, Custom Title, Exception  Overlay
General.Special Features: Up to 300 Presets, 5 Pattern, 8  (up to 32 presets per tour) Tour, 5 Scan
General.Privacy Mask: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.IR Control: Zoom Prio, Manual, Smart IR, Off
General.Video Compression: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG (Sub Stream 1)
General.Audio Compression: PCM, G.711A, G.711MU, G.726, MPEG2- Layer2, G.722.1, AAC
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Crossing Virtual Fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned Object, Fast Moving, Parking        Detection, Crowd Gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection, IMD
General.Protocols: IPv4, IPv6, HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, RTP, RTSP, RTCP, RTMP, SMTP V3, SFTP, DHCP, DNS, QoS,  UPnP, NTP, Multicast, ICMP, IGMP, NAS, PPPoE, SNMP, Auto Connect, TLS v1.2 and v1.3,  ONVIF (Profile S, Profile G, Profile T), InstaOn
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture, Recording, Send email, Preset, Tour, Pattern, Alarm digital output
General.Event Alarm: Motion Detection, Defocus Detection, Disk Full, Disk Error, Video Tampering, External Alarm,  Security Warning, Audio Detection,  AI Event
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, Trusted execution, Digest, Security logs,  WSSE, Account lockout, Syslog, Video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS,  Trusted upgrade, Trusted boot, Firmware encryption
General.Face Detection: Face detection, Face Enhancement,  Face Cutout(Face/ One Inch Photo), Snapshot Mode      (Real- Time/ Quality Priority), Optimal face snapshot upload, Quality Threshold
General.Certificates: ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, ISO 14001 : 2015, ISO 45001 : 2018, ISO 50001:2018, CE,  FCC and RoHS, BIS, STQC approved compliance report
General.Weatherproof Standard: IP67, IK10, TVS 6000V lightning proof, surge  protection, voltage transient protection
